_comment: User-level hook entries merged into ~/.claude/settings.json by scripts/settings-hooks.sh.
These CANNOT ship in hooks/hooks.json: the Claude desktop app serves plugin bundles from a
server-ingested rpm/ cache that can freeze weeks behind the CLI install, so a plugin-declared
hook never activates in the very environment it exists to protect, and ${CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT}
resolves into that frozen bundle. User settings are the only layer outside the freeze.

The same guard is registered twice on purpose: UserPromptSubmit catches a typed /workbench-* command early, PreToolUse(Skill) catches a skill invoked from prose. Only the second fires when the user says 'run the memory lint'.
